__**Explanation:**__

**Velocity-Time Graph and Negative Slope**

**Definition:** A velocity-time graph is a graphical representation that shows how the velocity of an object changes with time. In this graph, the y-axis represents velocity, while the x-axis represents time. The slope of the graph at any point provides information about the object's acceleration or deceleration.
